metadata.title: Dentnord — Surgical guides for dental implants
metadata.description: Digital implant planning and custom surgical guides for dental clinics, planned and printed in Denmark.

meta.title: Dentnord — Precise surgical guides for implant dentists
meta.description: Send your CBCT and intraoral scan. Dentnord plans the implant positions with you and delivers a printed, sleeve-ready surgical guide to your clinic.

hero.title: Precise surgical guides for implant dentists.
hero.subtitle: Send your CBCT and intraoral scan. We plan the implant positions with you and deliver a printed, sleeve-ready guide to your clinic.

workflow.label: How it works
workflow.title: From scan to guide in four steps

scans.title: Send your scans
scans.body: Upload CBCT (DICOM) and intraoral scans (STL/PLY) securely in the portal.

planning.title: Digital planning
planning.body: We plan the implant positions prosthetically, with your implant system and kit.

approve.title: You approve the plan
approve.body: Review the plan online, then approve it or ask for changes.

shipped.title: Printed & shipped
shipped.body: Your guide is printed, fitted with sleeves and shipped to your clinic.

home.statement: Precision is planned, not hoped for. Every guide starts from your scans and a plan you have reviewed and approved, so the surgery follows the plan and the day itself holds fewer surprises.

services.label: Services
services.title: Planning and guides for every implant case
